#!/usr/bin/python3
import os
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
RECEIVED = os.path.join(BASE, "received")
MAX_BODY = 65536


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def _reply(self, status, body=b""):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Connection", "close")
        self.end_headers()
        if body and self.command != "HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(body)
        self.close_connection = True

    def _not_found(self):
        self._reply(404, b"Not Found\n")

    def handle_expect_100(self):
        if self.path != "/upload":
            self._not_found()
            return False
        length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        try:
            size = int(length)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            self._reply(411, b"Content-Length required\n")
            return False
        if size < 0:
            self._reply(400, b"Invalid Content-Length\n")
            return False
        if size > MAX_BODY:
            self._reply(413, b"Payload Too Large\n")
            return False
        self.send_response_only(100)
        self.end_headers()
        return True

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path != "/upload":
            self._not_found()
            return
        if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding"):
            self._reply(400, b"Content-Length required\n")
            return
        length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        try:
            size = int(length)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            self._reply(411, b"Content-Length required\n")
            return
        if size < 0:
            self._reply(400, b"Invalid Content-Length\n")
            return
        if size > MAX_BODY:
            self._reply(413, b"Payload Too Large\n")
            return

        data = self.rfile.read(size)
        if len(data) != size:
            self.close_connection = True
            return

        os.makedirs(RECEIVED, mode=0o755, exist_ok=True)
        name = "upload-%d-%s.bin" % (time.time_ns(), uuid.uuid4().hex)
        final_path = os.path.join(RECEIVED, name)
        temp_path = None
        try:
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
                mode="wb", dir=RECEIVED, prefix=".upload-", suffix=".part", delete=False
            ) as output:
                temp_path = output.name
                output.write(data)
                output.flush()
                os.fsync(output.fileno())
            os.replace(temp_path, final_path)
            temp_path = None
        finally:
            if temp_path is not None:
                try:
                    os.unlink(temp_path)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass

        self._reply(200, (name + "\n").encode("ascii"))

    do_GET = _not_found
    do_HEAD = _not_found
    do_PUT = _not_found
    do_DELETE = _not_found
    do_PATCH = _not_found
    do_OPTIONS = _not_found

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        super().log_message(fmt, *args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.makedirs(RECEIVED, mode=0o755, exist_ok=True)
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.daemon_threads = True
    server.serve_forever()
PY_EOF
